title: Nine Years of Teaching
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（生活与学习·家庭与亲情）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（生活与学习·家庭与亲情）　|　核心词汇：child　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 child 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1947 my mother was sent to teach ① child she could not reach, and she said the teaching was the whole of the lesson. The ② child, meaning the boy and not the age, was nine years old and was taught by whoever came last; child, she said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ child in that house had the same question, and the ④ child at the end, meaning the one the aunt kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever taught properly. Child, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ child was the whole of the family, meaning the future it carried and not the boy. The ⑥ child, meaning the future and not any of that, is the only thing in a family that everybody protects and nobody questions; child, he said, is either something you teach or the only word that means both a boy and a future. She said the future is the part they remember.

By 1962 the ⑦ child had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the question. The ⑧ child of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine years and eleven years of teaching; child, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ child I remember is the one at the end, which was taught in 1967 and is still described as the quietest in the county. A ⑩ child, my grandmother said in 1972, is the only thing that improves by being taught; every child, she said, is a future that has agreed to look like a boy. She said the future was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 孩子（指那个男孩本身，与那个年纪相对）
C. 固定搭配：teach a child 教一个孩子
D. n. 孩子（指那栋房子里每一个）
E. n. 孩子（指末尾那一个）
F. n. 未来（抽象：它承载的那个前程）
G. n. 那个前程（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The child, meaning the boy and not the age
child was the whole of the family
the child had become a number in a report
The child of the whole thing
A child, my grandmother said in 1972

answers.why: teach a child 意为“教一个孩子”，1947 年母亲被派去教她够不着心思的那个孩子。
child 意为“孩子、儿童”，指那个男孩本身而不是那个年纪，九岁，由最后来的人教。
child 指那栋房子里每一个孩子，每一个都是同样的问题。
child 指末尾那一个（姑姑留下的那一个），是唯一有人认真教过的。
child 意为“未来”，抽象指它承载的那个前程，父亲说 child 就是那个家的全部。
child 为抽象用法，指那个前程本身，是一个家里人人都护着、却没人质疑的东西。
child 意为“孩子、儿童”，到 1962 年这个 child 成了报告里的一个数字。
child 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九岁和十一年的教学。
child 意为“孩子”，我记得的是末尾那一个，1967 年教过，至今仍被说成全县最安静的。
child 为抽象总称，祖母说一个孩子是唯一会因为被认真教导而变好的东西。
